Integrated Brunn–Minkowski yields the exact monomial mean Φ_s on each cell. For a≥b every mixed monomial is at least b^s, leaving the stated absolute-variation coefficient; the formula also holds when a=b or b=0.
Unimodality gives both the adjacent minimum sum T−W and total variation 2W−w₀−w_{N−1}; checked the plateau, N=1 and empty conventions. Only nonnegative unsampled outer volume is dropped.

The cone to the next grid point has weights W,0 and volume hW/(s+1), proving optimality. The exact sampled-peak verifier passed. Source d46094c158197e98 §§1–2 contains these bounds and the same equality example for the coefficient.

overlap.comparison: The full-sampled-rank volume bound at fine rank one gives hT/(s+1) when the sampled projection spans. It does not give the W and variation term, and its rank assumption excludes single-sample levels.
The projection-length result bounds sampling discrepancy using the peak over all real fibers. The claimed sharper lower bound uses the actual sampled peak and its adjacent variation.
